description: A record whose date equals one of the target dates of a calendar-based intent

entityType.description: Type of the matched record, e.g. invoice

targetDate.description: The record's date, one of the rule's target dates (YYYY-MM-DD)

createdByUserId.description: UUID of the user who created the record

assigneeUserIds.description: UUIDs of the users the record is assigned to, e.g. an order's assignee or the members of a task's team

identifiers.description: Human-readable identifiers of the record, field name to value, e.g. vendorInvoiceNo, poNumber, or poLineNumber and titleOrPackage

parentId.description: UUID of the parent record, e.g. the purchase order of an order line

acqUnitIds.description: UUIDs of the acquisition units the record belongs to
